addCustomModelSheet.title: Add Custom Model
addCustomModelSheet.description: Register a model ID that was not discovered by a provider key. The model is added to the pricing catalog so it becomes routable; set pricing and limits via Edit on the model row afterwards.
addCustomModelSheet.modelIdHint: The exact model ID your clients send in the `model` field. Must match what the provider API serves.

addCustomProviderSheet.name: Name

baseUrlDesc.openai: Provider API path (e.g. https://api.your-provider.com/openai). Endpoint suffixes like /v1/chat/completions are appended automatically per request type — do NOT include them here.
baseUrlDesc.anthropic: Provider API path (e.g. https://api.your-provider.com/anthropic). Endpoint suffixes like /v1/messages are appended automatically per request type — do NOT include them here.
baseUrlDesc.gemini: Provider API path (e.g. https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta). Gemini endpoints do not include a version prefix, so include /v1beta (or your equivalent version segment) here.
baseUrlDesc.cohere: Provider API path (e.g. https://api.your-provider.com/cohere). Endpoint suffixes like /v1/models and /v2/chat are appended automatically per request type — do NOT include them here.
baseUrlDesc.bedrock: Bedrock uses AWS SigV4 signing rather than a Base URL. This field has no effect for Bedrock — configure access via IAM credentials instead.
baseUrlDesc.replicate: Provider API path (e.g. https://api.your-provider.com/replicate). Endpoint suffixes like /v1/deployments and /v1/predictions are appended automatically per request type — do NOT include them here.
baseUrlDesc.default: Provider API path (e.g. https://api.your-provider.com/openai). Endpoint suffixes are appended automatically per request type — do NOT include them here. To customize individual paths, use Request Path Overrides below.

addCustomProviderSheet.allowPrivateNetworkDesc: Allow connecting to private network IPs (e.g. 192.168.x.x, 10.x.x.x). Link-local addresses remain blocked.
addCustomProviderSheet.isKeylessDesc: Whether the custom provider requires a key

network.streamIdleTimeoutDescription: Max time to wait for next chunk before closing a stalled stream
network.maxConnectionsPerHostDescription: Max TCP connections per provider host. For HTTP/2 providers (e.g. Bedrock), each connection supports ~100 concurrent streams.
network.keepAliveTimeoutDescription: Idle keep-alive for pooled connections. Set below the upstream server's keep-alive to avoid reusing connections it has already closed.
network.enforceHttp2Description: Force HTTP/2 on provider connections. Relevant for net/http-based providers (e.g. Bedrock) where each HTTP/2 connection supports ~100 concurrent streams.
network.allowPrivateNetworkDescription: Allow connections to private IPs (e.g. 10.x, 192.168.x). Required for providers on a LAN, k8s pod network, or private VPC. Cloud metadata addresses (169.254.x.x) are always blocked.
network.skipTlsVerificationDescription: Disable TLS certificate verification for provider connections. This bypasses server certificate validation and should be used only as a last resort when a trusted CA chain cannot be configured. Prefer ca_cert_pem for self-signed or private CA deployments.
network.caCertificateDescription: PEM-encoded CA certificate to trust for provider endpoint connections (e.g. self-signed or internal CA).

toast.baseUrlRequired: Base URL is required for custom providers

tooltip.noChangesAndErrors: No changes made and validation errors present

proxy.caCertDescription: PEM-encoded CA certificate to trust for TLS connections through SSL-intercepting proxies. You can also use env.YOUR_PROXY_CA_CERT_VAR.
proxy.alertDescription: Configure a proxy server for this provider. Proxy settings are applied per-provider and will be used for all outbound requests.

apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.weightTooltip: Controls the proportion of requests routed to this key. Higher values receive more traffic.
apiKeys.apiKeyVertexOnly: (Supported only for gemini and fine-tuned models)
apiKeys.allowedModelsTooltip: Select specific models this key applies to, or choose "Allow All Models" to allow all. Leave empty to deny all. Aliases must be added by their alias name - listing only the underlying model does not allow the alias (an alias best-model → gpt-4o requires "best-model" here, not just "gpt-4o").
apiKeys.blockedModelsTooltip: Models this key must never serve. The denylist always wins - if a model appears in both Allowed Models and here, it is blocked. Select "All Models" to block every model on this key. Aliases are matched by their alias name - blocking only the underlying model does not block aliases that point to it.
apiKeys.deploymentsDescription: Map a request model name to the provider's identifier (deployment name, inference profile ID, fine-tuned endpoint ID, etc.). Expand a row to set the canonical model name, model family, and provider-specific overrides - these power cost/pricing logs and family-based routing.
apiKeys.credentialsStoredSecurely: Credentials are stored securely. Edit to update.
apiKeys.useForBatchApisDescription: When enabled, this key will be used for batch API requests.
apiKeys.useAnthropicEndpointsDescription: Routes chat completions and responses requests through Anthropic-compatible endpoints.

vpcEndpoints.title: VPC Endpoints (Optional)
vpcEndpoints.description: Override the default public AWS Bedrock endpoints with PrivateLink VPC endpoint DNS names. pg-gateway dials each service through its corresponding VPC endpoint.

control_plane.label: Control Plane
control_plane.description: Serves model listing and batch jobs.

s3.label: S3
s3.description: Serves batch file I/O. Requires the bucket-prefixed endpoint name. A Gateway endpoint needs no value here.

azure.defaultCredentialDescription: Uses DefaultAzureCredential - automatically detects managed identity on Azure VMs and containers, workload identity in AKS, environment variables, and Azure CLI. No credentials required.
azure.scopesTooltip: Optional OAuth scopes for token requests. By default we use https://cognitiveservices.azure.com/.default - add additional scopes here if your setup requires extra permissions.

vertex.serviceAccountAttachedDescription: Uses the service account attached to your environment (GCE, GKE, Cloud Run). No credentials required.
vertex.projectNumber: Project Number (Required only for fine-tuned models)
vertex.regionDescription: Multi-region-only models are automatically routed to Google's matching multi-region endpoint. Turn on
vertex.regionDescriptionSuffix: below to always use exactly this region.
vertex.authCredentialsDescription: Service account JSON object or env.VAR_NAME
vertex.apiKeyOnlyGemini: API Key (Supported only for gemini and fine-tuned models)
vertex.forceSingleRegionDescription: Always call the region set above and skip automatic promotion of multi-region-only models to a multi-region endpoint. Enable when serving these models from a single region via provisioned throughput.

replicate.useDeploymentsEndpointDescription: Route requests through the Replicate deployments endpoint instead of the models endpoint.

vllm.serverUrlDescription: Base URL of the vLLM server (e.g. http://vllm-server:8000 or env.VLLM_URL)
vllm.modelNameDescription: Exact model name served on this vLLM instance

keylessProvider.ollamaServerUrlDescription: Base URL of the Ollama server (e.g. http://localhost:11434 or env.OLLAMA_URL)
keylessProvider.sglServerUrlDescription: Base URL of the SGLang server (e.g. http://localhost:30000 or env.SGL_URL)

bedrock.iamRoleDescription: Uses IAM roles attached to your environment (EC2, Lambda, ECS, EKS).
bedrock.apiKeyDescription: Uses a Bearer token for API key authentication.
bedrock.mantleProjectIdDescription: Scopes Bedrock Mantle-routed models (OpenAI-family / Gemma) to a specific project via the OpenAI-Project header. Leave empty to use the account's default project.
bedrock.assumeRoleArnDescription: Assume an IAM role before requests. Works with both explicit credentials and inherited IAM (EC2, ECS, EKS).
bedrock.externalIdDescription: Required by the role's trust policy when using cross-account access
bedrock.batchRoleArnDescription: Service role Bedrock assumes for batch S3 access. When set, it takes priority over the role_arn sent in requests.

bedrockMantle.iamRoleDescription: Uses IAM roles attached to your environment (EC2, Lambda, ECS, EKS).
bedrockMantle.apiKeyDescription: Uses a Bedrock Mantle API key sent as a Bearer token.
bedrockMantle.projectIdDescription: Scopes inference and model listing to a specific Bedrock project (sent as the OpenAI-Project / anthropic-workspace-id header). Leave empty to use the account's default project.
bedrockMantle.assumeRoleArnDescription: Assume an IAM role before requests. Works with both explicit credentials and inherited IAM (EC2, ECS, EKS).
bedrockMantle.externalIdDescription: Required by the role's trust policy when using cross-account access.
